**Validator Name:** Tecnodes Network Support  We are currently validating on multiple blockchain ecosystems including Atomone, Supra, Dymension, Aztec, Somnia, Avail, SEDA, Redbelly, SQD, and several other Cosmos, EVM, and Substrate networks, reflecting our established presence and trusted reputation in the validator ecosystem as a professional security audited company.

 **Digital Presence & Contact:** 

 Website: www.tecnodes.network

 X (Twitter): https://x.com/tecnodesnetwork

 Telegram: tecnodes_network 

 Discord: tecnodes

**Why gno.land** 

 We are deeply interested in validating on gno.land due to its innovative smart contract platform and unique approach to blockchain development. Gno.land's emphasis on simplicity, security, and developer experience aligns perfectly with our expertise in blockchain security auditing. The platform's potential to revolutionize smart contract development through its Go-based programming model represents a significant advancement in the space that we want to actively support.

 **Contributions**

 As an active contribution to the gno.land ecosystem, we are currently running a Topaz & have particpated in Test6, Test7, Test8, Test9, Test11 and Test12  node to support network stability and testing. Moving forward, we plan to contribute to our highest capacity by leveraging our security audit expertise to help identify potential vulnerabilities furthermore we would provide RPC, API & snapshots services, participate in governance decisions, and provide technical feedback to improve the platform's security posture. Our experience as professional validator positions us uniquely to contribute meaningful insights for the network's long-term security and decentralization goals. Note: for testnet we are using data-center, however for mainnet we'll use on-prem hosting.

At NodesHub, we are a professional blockchain infrastructure provider specializing in validator services, RPC endpoints, and IBC relaying. With extensive experience across diverse ecosystems, we deliver robust, secure, and highly available infrastructure for Web3 networks.  Networks You Are Currently Validating: We actively validate on 40+ blockchain networks, including Cosmos-based chains and emerging smart contract platforms. Our infrastructure is optimized for uptime, performance, and rapid recovery.  Full List of Networks: https://nodeshub.online/ Links to Your Digital Presence: •Website: https://nodeshub.online •X\\\(Twitter\\\): https://x.com/Nodes_Hub •GitHub: https://github.com/NodesHub Contact Details: •Email: contact@nodeshub.online •Telegram: https://t.me/V_NodesHub •Discord ID: nodeshub Why You Are Interested in Validating on gno.land: We are excited to support Gno.land because of its modular design, developer-first philosophy, and community-centric values all of which align with our mission at NodesHub. Our team shares the long-term vision of building decentralized, composable, and developer-friendly ecosystems, and we’re eager to contribute to Gno.land as it grows.  Contributions to gno.land: - Public RPC Infrastructure: We will deploy and maintain reliable public RPC endpoints to support developers and indexers. - Snapshot Services: Daily snapshot generation for faster node synchronization and chain onboarding - IBC Relayer Support: We plan to enable seamless IBC connections as soon as Gno.land supports IBC integrations - Community Engagement: Active involvement in governance, forums, and contributing to documentation and tooling as needed.
